page.layout: One page of text, centred block of title and verse on the right-centre; faint show-through from the reverse side (mirrored title and text, printer's device and imprint) which is not transcribed.

main_text.head: PSAL. 92.
main_text.p: Iustus vt palma germinabit, tanquam cedrus in Libano succrescet cum augmento. Plantati in domo Iehouæ: in atriis Dei nostri florebunt.

page.notes: Show-through from the verso only (mirrored title "...ARTIS ... AFOSTOLI ... PAVLI AD COLOSSENSES ... Sebastiani ... Basileae" and a woodcut device). Most of the page is blank. The faint text is not transcribed as it is not printed on this side. The verse is set in larger type and is taken as the single heading line PSAL. 92.; the verse text beneath is one paragraph.
